name: smwmusic-touhou-suimusou-immaterial-and-missing-power-everlasting-struggle-broken-moon-smw-mix
title: Touhou Suimusou ~ Immaterial and Missing Power - Everlasting Struggle ~ Broken Moon (SMW-Mix)
description:
𝕊𝕠𝕣𝕣𝕪, 𝕤𝕠𝕣𝕣𝕪. 𝕀 𝕕𝕣𝕒𝕟𝕜 𝕥𝕠𝕠 𝕞𝕦𝕔𝕙.

Not often that I do unsampled or light ports, but I did a remix of Suika Ibuki's theme, Broken Moon, from Touhou 7.5, with a hint of Septette for the Dead Princess in there (inspired by this arrangement of the song).

This baby can work in night, athletic, eastern, & mountain stages.

Also, it's almost been one year since my first port (which was Drunk As I Like, another theme song for Suika but from Touhou 10.5). Perfect timing for this song I'd say! :)

Note:
There are two customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the .txt file:
- b minor (Remix - Default Set)
- c minor (Original)
